hero.headline: Tracking Environmental Restoration & Community Resilience Outcomes
hero.subheadline: Demonstrating how afforestation, agroforestry, and riparian restoration mitigate extreme flooding, stabilize vulnerable hillsides, and create green livelihoods.

stories.title: Latest Field Stories & Impact Reports
stories.subtitle: Evidence-based community impact narratives linking hillside restoration to household resilience.
stories.story1_title: Bio-Engineering the Mpazi Ravine: Protecting Nyabugogo from Flash Flooding
stories.story1_desc: How vegetative check-dams, bamboo riparian buffers, and contour swales delay torrential runoff in upper basins, protecting informal settlements and markets downstream.
stories.story2_title: Women at the Helm: Female-Led Nursery Cooperatives Powering Reforestation
stories.story2_desc: Over 61% of community seedling nurseries are now operated by women's cooperatives, converting restoration finance into sustainable household income.
stories.story3_title: Youth GIS Environmental Stewards: Digital Telemetry for Forest Tracking
stories.story3_desc: Empowering next-generation youth technicians with mobile mapping tools and drone spatial analysis to verify tree survival benchmarks directly across field compartments.

climate.name: Climate Adaptation
climate.short_desc: Mitigating flood risks, preventing severe landslides, and reducing stormwater runoff across steep hillsides and ravines.
climate.headline: Building Climate Resilience from Hilltops to Riverbeds
climate.what_is_it: Climate adaptation interventions deploy ecological engineering—such as agroforestry terracing, bamboo buffer strips, and slope reforestation—to absorb extreme rainfall, stabilize fragile soils, and buffer downstream communities against flash floods.
climate.why_it_matters: Intensified rainfall and rapid urbanization drive severe flooding in downstream basins, damaging roads, homes, and critical economic hubs. Restoring upper catchment hydrology mitigates disaster risks for vulnerable residents.
climate.what_action_does: Field teams restore steep upstream slopes across Yanze, Mpazi, and Mount Kigali. By combining progressive terracing with native vegetative ground cover, stormwater runoff is captured before reaching informal settlements and commercial centers.

biodiversity.name: Biodiversity Protection
biodiversity.short_desc: Restoring native tree species, establishing 30-meter riparian buffers along rivers, and reviving ecological corridors.
biodiversity.headline: Restoring Indigenous Flora & Critical Riverine Corridors
biodiversity.what_is_it: Biodiversity protection focuses on rehabilitating native tree species (such as Polyscias fulva, Markhamia lutea, and Ficus thonningii) and conserving vital 30-meter riparian buffer belts along riverbanks and tributary wetlands.
biodiversity.why_it_matters: Decades of agricultural encroachment and monoculture tree plantations have fragmented natural wildlife corridors and reduced soil moisture retention. Healthy native river corridors safeguard water quality for downstream water treatment intakes.
biodiversity.what_action_does: Implementing partners work with environmental agencies to plant over 1.2 million seedlings, establish native riparian buffer strips along 45 km of riverbanks, build community seedbanks, and track tree survival with GPS monitoring.

gesi.name: Gender Equality & Inclusion (GESI)
gesi.short_desc: Empowering women leaders in watershed committees, engaging youth in GIS environmental tracking, and uplifting vulnerable households.
gesi.headline: Centering Women and Youth in Climate Governance
gesi.what_is_it: Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) integrates women, youth, and historically marginalized households as direct decision-makers, managers, and beneficiaries across all catchment restoration operations.
gesi.why_it_matters: Women and youth are disproportionately affected by climate disasters like floods and mudslides, yet frequently lack formal land tenure and representation in water committees. Sustainable outcomes require equitable local ownership and leadership.
gesi.what_action_does: The program mandates 50%+ female representation on catchment management committees, provides dedicated seed capital to women-led tree nursery cooperatives, and trains local youth as certified environmental stewards in drone and GIS tracking.

economy.name: Employment & Economy
economy.short_desc: Generating green employment, empowering smallholder agroforestry farmers, and creating revenue from community-run tree nurseries.
economy.headline: Generating Sustainable Green Jobs & Rural-Urban Livelihoods
economy.what_is_it: The economic pillar links environmental restoration with dignified green livelihoods—including cash-for-work in terracing, commercial fruit and macadamia agroforestry, and seedling nursery sales.
economy.why_it_matters: Peri-urban communities need resilient, diversified economic opportunities that reward sustainable stewardship over resource depletion, ensuring restoration gains persist for generations.
economy.what_action_does: Field initiatives have generated paid green employment, equipped 2,850+ farmers with high-yield fruit trees (avocado and macadamia), and generated over 48 million RWF in local nursery revenues.

registry_interoperability.title: Open Data & Spatial Registry Interoperability
registry_interoperability.subtitle: Engineered for zero-lock-in data exchange with municipal and environmental monitoring registries.
registry_interoperability.card1_desc: Every intervention site links to official compartment IDs (e.g., COMP-GAS-JB-01) and ecological taxonomies.
registry_interoperability.card2_desc: All indicators and polygons can be programmatically queried via standard JSON endpoints or downloaded in one click.
registry_interoperability.card3_desc: Built as a modular web application with pluggable adapters so technical teams can maintain and host it freely.

footer.about: Impact Dashboard is an open-data indicator tracking and spatial analytics platform supporting multi-stakeholder climate resilience, environmental stewardship, and inclusive community development.
footer.rights: All public monitoring data released under Open Data principles for transparency and evidence-based decision-making.
